svg.aria-label: Where each model falls: hidden-test passes per rung over three climbs
svg.text: Where each model falls: hidden-test passes per rung over three climbs
Rows are runs; a cell is how many of the three climbs passed every hidden case on that rung.
Rungs 9 and 12 are the ceiling for every local model; the cloud tags clear them. The c5d2 rows are the same two models before rung 15's clock was moved into the worker.
